name: Hanabi Hyuga
source:
Hanabi Hyūga is a kunoichi from Konohagakure and the heiress of the Hyūga clan. Hanabi is a young woman with long, dark brown hair and lavender eyes. Hanabi is the younger daughter of the Hyūga clan's head, Hiashi Hyūga. During sparring sessions between Hanabi and [url=https://vndb.org/c105111]her sister[/url], Hanabi's talent began to shine, amazing everyone by being about on par with her older sister despite their age difference.
She's the captain of Team 15.
